messages:
maria.santos: quick heads-up — I finished a lightweight audit coverage inventory for customer-facing audit events. high level: api-gateway, auth, console, billing, runtime all have holes, but different flavors.

anil.kumar: thanks — can you call out the biggest customer-facing risks?

maria.santos: sure. top 3: 1) gateway->auth token refresh/fail events missing for some 4xx/5xx paths, 2) console: priv escalation events don't include target_resource id in ~30% of flows, 3) runtime: background job-driven actions (bulk prompt reruns) don't emit request_origin/initiator.

julie: do we have a simple repro or sample missing payload?

maria.santos: posted a trimmed example below — this is what we expect vs what we see.

maria.santos: ```expected event schema
{
  "event_type": "console.role.change",
  "initiator": {"id": "user:U123", "email": "u@example.com"},
  "target_resource": {"type": "org", "id": "org:O456"},
  "actor_ip": "3.4.5.6",
  "timestamp": "2026-02-12T18:22:33Z"
}

actual seen in logs:
{
  "event_type": "console.role.change",
  "initiator": {"id": "user:U123"},
  "timestamp": "2026-02-12T18:22:33Z"
}
```

tom_g: ugh — missing target_resource blocks customer evidence requests. that's a blocker for SOC2 evidence collections.

lia: what about KMS/RBAC related events? any gaps there?

maria.santos: KMS integration emits key.access events but lacks caller_identity in some service-to-service flows. RBAC deltas (policy updates) are captured, but we don't always include the policy_snapshot version — makes diffs hard for auditors.

anil.kumar: can we map these gaps to owners and severity so we can triage into the backlog?

maria.santos: I created a quick priority matrix:
- P0: console missing target_resource for role changes (affects audits) -> owner: console-platform (julie)
- P1: gateway->auth missing refresh_fail events on 5xx paths -> owner: api-gateway (tom_g)
- P1: runtime missing initiator for scheduled bulk jobs -> owner: runtime-workers (lia)
- P2: KMS missing caller_identity in svc-svc flows -> owner: infra-kms (anil.kumar)
- P2: billing missing invoice delivery audit detail (recipient email/hash) -> owner: billing (unassigned)

julie: assigning console-platform to take P0. i'll schedule a spike tomorrow to trace the request path and ensure we enrich the audit event with target_resource and policy_snapshot.

tom_g: i'll pick up the gateway case. probably a filter around the auth proxy is dropping the body when we fall back to the legacy auth handler. quick fix might be to capture a minimal envelope.

lia: runtime — i can add initiator propagation to the job scheduler metadata and emit initiator when jobs are queued/executed. will open PR after design doc.

anil.kumar: for KMS I'll look at service account flows. maybe we need to add caller_identity to the key access wrapper. if it's a breaking schema change we should version the event type.

maria.santos: schema change note: prefer additive fields and event versioning. propose adding "event_version": "v2" and new optional fields: target_resource, initiator.email, policy_snapshot. backward compat: old consumers should ignore unknown fields.

maria.santos: sample event header we can standardize on:
```json
{"event_id":"evt_...","event_type":"...","event_version":"v2","service":"console"}
```

julie: regarding customer-facing validation: we should add an automated check in the evidence pipeline that validates required fields for SOC-relevant events and fails gating export if missing. can we add a lightweight schema validator?

maria.santos: yes — i'll draft a small JSONSchema and a CI job that runs against a sample event set nightly. also add a webhook that can run on-demand for customer evidence requests.

tom_g: timeline proposals: P0 fix -> 2 sprints (investigate + small release), P1s -> 1-2 sprints each, P2s -> grooming.

anil.kumar: i'll book a triage slot in backlog grooming for friday. can everyone add acceptance criteria to their assigned ticket before then?

lia: adding AC: for runtime, events must include initiator.id and initiator.type for all scheduled and ad-hoc bulk jobs; include one integration test.

julie: AC for console: role change events must include target_resource.{type,id}, initiator.email or id, and policy_snapshot.version. tests + e2e evidence export.

maria.santos: FYI I've flagged a customer request (sales-ticket #4321) that will need P0 ETA for SOC evidence. please treat that as high-impact when estimating.

ops-oncall: @here if any of these fixes touch prod auth proxies, coordinate with oncall before rollout — include rollout plan and automatic rollback on error spikes.

anil.kumar: noted. will include canary and percentage ramp with quick rollback hooks.

maria.santos: next steps: i'll open the master tracking ticket with the mapping and owners, attach sample events, JSONSchema drafts, and the customer ticket link. please comment there. thanks all. :thumbsup:

sec-bot: Audit coverage inventory created by @maria.santos. Items assigned: console-platform (julie), api-gateway (tom_g), runtime-workers (lia), infra-kms (anil.kumar), billing (unassigned).
